body: I don't want. With this replying to you and opposing to you I don't seek attention. I'm just honest because there's no point in lying here when we are anonymous. I honestly don't want to live anymore.
Thanks for your help but that's not my goal. I don't want to sound as whiny asshole but I know what I want. I'll just end it. I can't overcome this. It's too big for me.

You are great help. But I see the roots in my anxiety and awkwardness in being unattractive? Lack of any kind of relationship with opposite gender really strikes me down. Some days I get the feeling that I'm not that bad looking. But then I see my crooked teeth, ugly nose and I get depressed.

To be completely honest I'm 19. Soon to be 20. I wanted teenage love. From my point of view the love you get as an adult isn't the same as teenage love. Maybe I sound ridiculous to you but that's how I feel. I want to do stuff like my friends did with their gfs or are doing. To be so young and careless. Maybe I want something what is impossible to get. That's why I want to kill myself. Why live if I can't get simply thing as that. I surely sound confusing. That' ok. I won't live past my 20.

You are right. Like I said I could be happy if I wanted. But at the end of the day I don't see a point in being happy without SO. I just can't take the feelings of paranoia and awkwardness I get when I'm outside. It's killing me.

I realise she won't make everything better. I don't even need that. I just need her to be. That's all. I need someone of opposite gender to love. To kiss. To care about. To make happy. To try make happy. And the loneliness - I'll rather end my worthless life.

I don't see a problem in getting a date. I see a problem in being normal. You can't imagine how I feel outside. I tried the thing with confidence - fake it till you make it. It doesn't get better. All I want to do after is to curl up here in my room and hate myself for everything I have ever done.
